name: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO)
definition: A hierarchical spatial subdivision data structure used in voxel engines to support visual level of detail (LoD) and provide tight compression of sparsely-populated spaces.
summary: A Sparse Voxel Octree is a hierarchical data structure that stores voxel data sparsely, distinguishing itself from flat grids by providing tight compression and from KD-trees by ensuring uniform subdivision for efficient ray-traced rendering.
